paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
notes: | Vision: The actual exclusion plot (FIG.4 top) has y-axis C_G/f_a [GeV^-1], the axion-gluon coupling that induces an oscillating neutron EDM, NOT d_n [e cm] directly. The hint suggested AxionEDM with d_n axis, but the published plot uses C_G/f_a. Values reported here are read off the C_G/f_a axis (GeV^-1), tracing the lower boundary of the nEDM excluded region (combined long+short time-base). Coupling type is uncertain — actual y-axis units are GeV^-1 not e*cm, so confidence is reduced. Peak sensitivity ~ f_a/C_G ~ 1e21 GeV (i.e. C_G/f_a ~ 1e-21 GeV^-1) at m_a < 1e-23 eV. | CV calibration unavailable (no plot region), used LLM axes | Calibration: No calibration needed
